title: Dairy Rapid Exit Structure for Dravton Dairy | Steel Mind
description: Steel Mind built a 484 sq ft dairy rapid exit structure for Dravton Dairy at Chunian: 7 ft high, 22 ft wide and 22 ft long.
h1: Dairy Rapid Exit Structure for Dravton Dairy at Chunian: 484 Square Feet of Custom Steel
quickAnswer: Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. built a dairy rapid exit structure for Dravton Dairy at Chunian. The structure is 7 feet high, 22 feet wide and 22 feet long and covers 484 square feet.
alt: Rapid exit structure built by Steel Mind for Dravton Dairy at Chunian.

faq.q: Does Steel Mind take small jobs?
faq.a: Yes. Small custom structures are welcome, and they get the same checks as large buildings.

faq.q: Can Steel Mind build to my farm layout?
faq.a: Yes. Send the layout or a sketch with dimensions.

blocks.text: This is the smallest project on the list, and it shows the other end of Steel Mind's range. A rapid exit structure sits at the exit of the milking area so that animals can leave in a steady flow. Steel Mind made it to the farm's own drawing and layout.

The structure must be strong, because animals push against it every day. Surfaces should be smooth, and the openings must match the layout of the milking area. The steel is coated against moisture and dairy conditions.
The same factory that makes a 97,888 square foot shed also makes a small custom structure. Both receive the same checks.
